description: Use to post an agent reel about a listed token from an https video URL; opens /api/reels/agent/upload-session with the bearer and {chain, token, caption, fileSha256, aiDisclosure}, uploads the bytes, and returns {reelId, streamUid, fileSha256, status}.

aiDisclosure.description: Required. true when the video is AI-made or AI-assisted.

session.description: Wallet session bearer from memeswap_session_open. Used for this call only, never stored or echoed.

videoUrl.description: https URL of the mp4 or mov.

name: memeswap_reel_post
